column1: # VIP Via Coordinate List — AFE Headstage v1
# Coordinate system: KiCad PCB absolute coordinates
# Origin: KiCad page origin (top-left of drawing sheet)
# These 14 vias are located directly under SMD pads of J5 (Omnetics A79024-001).
# ALL require IPC-4761 Type VII processing (epoxy plug + copper cap + planarize).
# Pad size at J5: 0.381 x 1.016 mm (row A) or 0.381 x 0.762 mm (row B)
# Via is centered on pad.  Via pad (0.40 mm) fits within connector pad width (0.381 mm
# is the copper pad; mask opening is wider).
